about: DEC19-BUDGET (2026-11-19, decision ENG52-1 b): the evolute play rate onto Hatchling cards. Decks: every road fight deck (tools/lib_bramble.js B.MAPS, all maps) and every PRO / BPRO / WPRO deck (canonical/pro-skirmishes.json maps.*). An evolute can land on a Hatchling card only when one deck holds both; none does, so the rate is 0 and Hatchling costs Stem 2 x 0 = 0.
